sentences.text: Edge offers AI-powered services such as daily personalised profile recommendations that aim to provide better matches and limit scrolling.
sentences.article_title: 'We're a capitalist society': Grindr defends $120 a month premium tier

sentences.text: The company's CEO, George Arison, told BBC News it would be a "very different Grindr experience" which was aimed at a "small community of users" - and was unapologetic about its cost.
sentences.article_title: 'We're a capitalist society': Grindr defends $120 a month premium tier

sentences.text: "I think we're a capitalist society, and everything hinges on whether you can afford it or not," he said.

sentences.text: Grindr has long had a free service, and offers two additional tiers that cost between $22.99 and $44.99 per month.

sentences.text: There was a mixed reaction from users BBC News spoke to in San Francisco to the  new, much more expensive version of the app.
sentences.article_title: 'We're a capitalist society': Grindr defends $120 a month premium tier

sentences.text: "The current premium Grindr tier is already really expensive," said a user named Rybin, who told the BBC the company's newest offering "just seems really out of touch with the community." sentences.article_title: 'We're a capitalist society': Grindr defends $120 a month premium tier

sentences.text: Both declined to give their last name.
sentences.article_title: 'We're a capitalist society': Grindr defends $120 a month premium tier

sentences.text: At least half a dozen Indian start-ups are using AI to map and report road damage to authorities In 2020, Sanjay Mandava flew down from Chicago to Chennai in southern India to resolve a personal land dispute.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Over the next few months, he was running around between government offices to access a dozen records that would conclusively prove that the property belonged to his family.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Just a sale deed dating back to when his parents bought the land was not enough.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Authorities asked him to produce a string of other documents.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Frustrated by the experience, he built Landeed - an AI-led digital platform that enables users to aggregate fragmented, multi-source land-records, verify titles and conduct legal checks at the click of a few buttons , across 24 states in India.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: He's solving a problem that is uniquely Indian.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: "In the US or UK, when you purchase a property, the government verifies ownership.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: In India by contrast, we follow presumptive titling - the buyer is responsible for establishing ownership.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: A sale deed merely records the transaction - multiple other documents may be needed to prove title," Mandava told the BBC.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: These include building certificates, property tax receipts and land survey maps among others.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: The system is rife for misuse - property disputes account for a bulk of civil litigation cases in the country where some 80% of household wealth is held in real estate.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Landeed has mapped large swathes of India using geo-spatial technology and data from state land revenue departments, registration offices, survey records and municipal databases.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Using this, it has linked registered properties to their official land identification and survey numbers and ownership records.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: An additional AI-layer can read these titles, extract information and spot inconsistencies within minutes - a process that takes lawyers and brokers several days.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: With the largest repository of title data in the country, consisting of 1.8 billion documents, the app is now used by millions of individual and enterprise customers while doing real estate transactions.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Unlike the US and China which have a global dominance in building frontier language models like ChatGPT, India's AI revolution is happening downstream in data centre infrastructure and consumer applications rather than in research.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Start-ups are solving issues for everything from pothole detection to tribal language translation to assisting overworked public-health professionals with medical tasks - often working with highly fragmented, multilingual datasets in extremely cost sensitive industries.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Bengaluru-based YouTube teacher Gaurav Sen's AI app detects potholes using a dash-cam, satellite-based navigation and an AI vision model to analyse images.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: It then identifies civic officials responsible for fixing them and sends them this data.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: He got viral attention recently given how widespread the menace of potholes is across India's urban sprawls.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: On last count, there are at least half a dozen other similar offerings that map and report road damage to authorities across the country.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: "A municipal corporation can take the app and use it on public buses and taxis, to access real-time, updated data on road conditions," Sen told the BBC.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: In Mumbai on India's western coast, Fractal Analytics - among the few Indian listed AI companies - has deployed its AI tool "Vaidya" in hospitals run by the local civic authority.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: The app allows citizens to receive AI-generated, simplified summaries of their lab reports in multiple languages, identify nearby healthcare facilities based on their needs and gives doctors AI-guided pre-consultation support such as medical history and medication details of patients.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: It also provides hospital administrators with a public health dashboard based on aggregated, anonymous insights from lab reports accessed through its tie-up with municipal hospitals, giving them crucial visibility into emerging infections or other disease trends.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: This boom has led to a surge in funding for AI start-ups - up 265% year-on-year according to Inc42 , external , a start-up information platform.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: They raised over $1bn in the first nine months of this year amid a relatively muted fundraising environment for the broader ecosystem.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Yet, these companies face an uphill task in commercialising their ideas and taking them beyond pilot.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: "The cost of building in India is sometimes much higher than what Indian customers are willing to pay," Fractal's co-founder Srikanth Velamakanni told the BBC at his sprawling office overlooking Mumbai's film city.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: "I believe I am building one of the most impactful things for this country," says Mandava.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: "But I am starved for GPUs [chips that perform millions of calculations and help train AI models].
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: I have a hellish time trying to acquire them," he says.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: The country has promised its start-ups 38,000 GPUs through its government-led AI mission , external , but demand for this compute power is far greater than supply.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Cumbersome regulation and bureaucracy are other major challenges.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: Fractal Analytics, a listed AI company has deployed its AI tool "Vaidya" in hospitals run by the Mumbai civic authority Without these fundamental issues being addressed, there's a risk that Indian AI companies will build shallow solutions that a next generation of founders will immediately make redundant, say experts.

sentences.text: "Someone like a Google will probably laugh if I tell them of my pilot.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: To make it sustainable and hard to replicate, it will have to be much more sophisticated," says Sen, displaying a self-awareness of where his product currently stands.
sentences.article_title: The AI start-ups fixing India's broken roads and messy land records

sentences.text: From a lack of experienced talent to the struggle to turn successful pilots into recurring government contracts to heavy dependence on expensive foreign technology, Indian founders  are powering through many odds.

sentences.text: We don't want protection, but propel us, give us the weapons to compete against the best," Mandava says, when asked what he wants from policymakers.

sentences.text: Han Won-seok confessed in a video on the YouTube account of his lawyer, Lee Don-Ho, adding that he had confessed to the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency and offered details on how he cheated.
sentences.article_title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating

sentences.text: The 34-year-old scored 397.5 out of 400 points in the first round, getting just one of 160 questions wrong, which initially raised suspicions and sparked online speculation.

sentences.text: Standardised national tests play an outsized role in career trajectories for South Koreans, making their results - and efforts to unduly inflate those results - of great importance.
sentences.article_title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating

sentences.text: "I cheated in both the first and second rounds of the tax account exam by using electronic devices and generative AI," Han said in the video published on Sunday.

sentences.text: This video can not be played Watch: US ground stop caused by issue during copper wire update, transport secretary says An upgrade to a decades-old telecoms network in the US caused the longest nationwide grounding of flights since the 11 September 2001 attacks.
sentences.article_title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos

sentences.text: Friday's stoppage occurred when part of a key system that allows air traffic controllers and pilots to communicate was switched to fibre from copper wiring so old it has been discontinued, said US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy on Saturday.
sentences.article_title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos

sentences.text: US planes were grounded for more than four hours, affecting thousands of flights and passengers.
sentences.article_title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos

sentences.text: Earlier Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there was no indication of a cyber-attack and that everybody was safe.
sentences.article_title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos

sentences.text: On Friday afternoon, a government contractor called L3Harris was continuing work on upgrading an aviation telecoms network.
sentences.article_title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos

sentences.text: As it swapped out copper lines for fibre at a remote location in the US, L3Harris installed a router - a piece of equipment which basically directs traffic across the network.
sentences.article_title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos

sentences.text: According to Duffy, that router started flooding others in the air traffic control system, sending 1,000 connection attempts every four to five seconds.
sentences.article_title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos

sentences.text: As a result, 17 out of 22 air route traffic control centres in the US experienced "instability" on voice and ground communications, said Bryan Bedford, administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA).

sentences.text: It took the aviation authority 45 minutes to identify where the problem was because maintenance is logged manually on paper.
